name: Cathedral of the Hollow Saint
author: SammiBabe666
description: A haunted hurdy-gurdy for the original Teenage Engineering OP-1: a kennel synth plugin (hollow_saint) for the Hundekraft OP-1 Workshop 3.0.x. Bowed melody strings, a drone that can hold a key like real bourdons, a buzzing bridge that kicks in on tempo-locked wheel strokes, and a cathedral that darkens, rings and tolls a distant bell.
